title: Two incomprehensible beings in a cave on Titan

tellings.quote: um I found these two beings in a cave.

plain: An Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says he found two beings in a cave on Titan, Saturn's largest moon, beings he could not make sense of. He tells Michels this as something he experienced himself, though the line quoted does not say how he came to be looking there. If true, it would mean life of some kind on another world.
